text: DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account 是 DSH 网页端的 WorkBuddy 多账号伴侣插件，依托 dsh-workbuddy-connect 接入 WorkBuddy 与 WorkBuddy AI 模型。它在 DSH 注册模型适配器并提供账号管理设置页，可导入桌面账号或授权文件、通过扫码添加账号、按限流策略轮换账号并自动续期令牌。还支持每账号独立模型组、跨账号共享推理档位和调整模型上下文窗口，适合需要管理多个 WorkBuddy 账号的 DSH 用户。登录及账号服务使用 WorkBuddy 官方服务；不要求用户配置 API key。

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account manages WorkBuddy accounts in DSH through dsh-workbuddy-connect. Its settings page imports accounts, adds them by QR sign-in, rotates on rate limits, and renews tokens. It also offers separate model groups and shared reasoning levels.
想让 DSH 在 WorkBuddy 限流后自动换到另一个账号。
我有好几个 WorkBuddy 账号，怎么在 DSH 里统一管理？

如何给每个 WorkBuddy 账号单独建一个可选模型组？

I want DSH to switch WorkBuddy accounts when one hits a rate limit.
Can I manage several WorkBuddy logins and choose a separate model group for each?
DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account 的功能「账号池管理」：按国内版和国际版维护 WorkBuddy 账号，并可导入授权文件或桌面应用账号。设置页支持启用、停用、重命名、删除和选择当前账号。
DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account 的功能「限流换号」：在限流时切换到可用 WorkBuddy 账号，也可选择逐次轮换或手动策略。限流事件进入轮换处理，账号池负责选择和更新当前账号。
DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account 的功能「扫码添加账号」：设置页生成 WorkBuddy 登录链接，用户扫码后轮询登录状态；成功后账号写入账号池，界面只接收账号资料。
DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account 的功能「按账号分组」：可为每个已启用账号注册独立模型适配器，并在模型选择器中单独选择；也可切回按版本合并的分组。
DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account 使用 WorkBuddy 官方服务处理扫码登录、账号信息和令牌续期请求，账号操作需要访问对应的 WorkBuddy 服务。
DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account 依赖 dsh-workbuddy-connect 提供 WorkBuddy 模型适配；该上游插件需同时安装，插件以其公开导出和 auth 文件环境变量接入。

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Introduction：

dsh-workbuddy-multi

在 DeepSeek Harness 里同时挂多个 WorkBuddy 账号：限流时自动切换、扫码添加、令牌自动续期。

中文 · English

本插件是 [dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 的伴侣插件。 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 负责把 WorkBuddy 的模型接进 DSH，本插件在它之上管理多个账号，不修改它的任何文件。

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · 功能：- **多账号轮换**：国内版、国际版各自维护一个账号池。一个账号触发频率限制或额度耗尽时，暂停到额度恢复的时刻，下一次请求直接使用下一个可用账号，不会再发给限流中的账号。
- **扫码添加账号**：在设置页生成 WorkBuddy 官方登录链接，用微信扫码即可加入账号池；也可以从桌面 App 导入当前登录的账号，或导入授权文件。
- **令牌自动续期**：定时刷新即将过期的令牌；需要重新登录的账号会单独标出。
- **积分合计**：按版本汇总池内所有已启用账号的积分，输入框旁显示合计值。
- **两种分组方式**：按版本合并成一个模型组（组内自动轮换），或每个账号单独一个模型组，在模型选择器里直接选。
- **推理档位共享**：上游的「推理等级」检测原本按账号各自进行，换一个没测过的账号档位就消失。开启后（默认开启），任一账号检测过的档位对同版本所有账号生效；检测只在设置页进行（可逐个、可全部、可重测），输入框里不会出现「推理等级」按钮。「端点不校验参数」的模型按惯例直接提供 low / medium / high / max 四档（实测生效）。
- **上下文选档**：目录声明了多档窗口的模型（如 GPT-6.1-Sol 的 272K/600K/1M），在模型列表里逐个模型选择窗口大小，或一键全部设为默认/最低/最高；模型选择器里的条目和名字不变。
- **设置即时生效并保存**：设置页的开关（模型分组、推理档位共享、输入框积分、上下文选档）立即生效，并保存在 `~/.dsh/workbuddy-pool/settings.json`，重启 DSH 后保持。
- **上游设置一条龙**：上游插件的账号状态、积分、模型列表刷新、模型可见性、最大上下文窗口、推理档位检测与版本更新检查，全部收进本插件的设置页，不用再到上游的卡片里操作。
- **自动安装依赖**：检测到没有 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 时，通过插件市场自动安装。

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · 安装：**从插件市场安装（推荐）**：打开 DSH 的「插件市场」，搜索 `dsh-workbuddy-multi`，点击安装。

**用命令行安装（dsh web）**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/richardhxwang/dsh-workbuddy-multi/releases/latest/download/dsh-workbuddy-multi.tgz
```

装好后刷新页面，在「插件」页打开 **dsh-workbuddy-multi** 即可看到设置页。

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · 依赖会自动安装：本插件需要 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 才能工作。从插件市场装好本插件后，它会立即检查依赖：如果还没装、或者装了但被停用，会自动通过插件市场安装或启用，并在右下角和设置页里显示进度，完成后按提示刷新页面或重启 DSH。自动安装失败时，提示里会给出原因和「重试」按钮；之后 6 小时内不再自动尝试，期间可随时点「一键安装」。

没有插件市场时无法自动安装，设置页会给出手动安装的命令： ```sh dsh plugin add dsh-workbuddy-connect ```

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · 添加账号：点击右上角「添加账号」，选择国内版或国际版，生成登录链接后在浏览器或手机中打开，用微信扫码。登录成功后账号立即加入账号池。 也可以在每个版本标题右侧的「⋯」菜单里： - **从桌面 App 导入当前账号**：读取 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 当前登录的账号。 - **导入授权文件**：选择授权文件（一次最多 10 个）；DSH 不在本机运行时，可展开「按路径导入」填写路径。

每个账号右侧的「⋯」菜单提供刷新令牌、停用 / 启用、重命名和删除。「设为当前」只对可用的账号显示。

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · 账号轮换：| 方式 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| **限流时切换**（默认） | 持续使用当前账号；触发频率限制或额度耗尽时，暂停该账号至额度恢复，并切换至下一个可用账号。 |
| **逐次轮换** | 每个请求依次使用下一个可用账号。 |
| **手动指定** | 不自动切换，只使用手动设为当前的账号。 |

只有 WorkBuddy 返回了额度恢复时间的限流才会暂停账号并切换，暂停到该时间为止。「模型繁忙」这类不带恢复时间的临时限流与账号无关，不切换账号，由 DSH 自动重试。
DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · 模型分组：| 方式 | 行为 | | --- | --- | | **按版本合并**（默认） | 国内版、国际版各一个模型组，组内账号自动轮换。 | | **按账号分组** | 每个账号对应一个模型组，在模型选择器中直接选用。新添加的账号即时出现。 |

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · 注意事项：- **不要在 dsh-workbuddy-connect 的设置里填写 auth 文件路径。** 那两项（`authFile` / `authFileAI`）的优先级高于本插件，填了以后自动轮换不会生效。检测到时设置页顶部会提示。
- **国内版账号只能在本机使用。** 国内版的凭据由本机 WorkBuddy App 的密钥加密，账号池拷到别的电脑上无法使用。
- **凭据只保存在本机**：`~/.dsh/workbuddy-pool/`（文件权限 0600）。设置页和接口都不会显示或返回任何令牌。
- 从桌面 App 导入的国内版账号，令牌由 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 在使用时刷新；想让它也能被自动续期，用「添加账号」扫码登录一次。

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · 配置项：一般不需要改。如需调整，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中添加（设置页上改过的开关以设置页为准）：

```yaml
- id: llm-workbuddy-multi
  config:
    cooldownMs: 1800000      # 额度用尽但无法得知恢复时间时的暂停时长（毫秒）
    keepalive: true          # 令牌自动续期

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · 开发：```sh
npm install
npm test
```

实现细节见 [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md)。

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Introduction：

dsh-workbuddy-multi

Run several WorkBuddy accounts in DeepSeek Harness: automatic switching on rate limits, QR sign-in, automatic token renewal.

中文 · English

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Introduction：A companion plugin for [dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect).
`dsh-workbuddy-connect` brings WorkBuddy's models into DSH; this plugin manages several accounts on top of it without modifying any of its files.

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Features：- **Account rotation** — one pool per edition (China and International). When an account hits a rate limit or runs out of quota, it is paused until the quota resets, and the next request goes straight to the next available account instead of trying the limited one again.
- **QR sign-in** — create an official WorkBuddy sign-in link in the settings page and scan it with WeChat. You can also import the account signed in to the desktop app, or import auth files.
- **Automatic token renewal** — tokens close to expiry are refreshed on a schedule; accounts that need to sign in again are flagged.
- **Credit totals** — credits of all enabled accounts are summed per edition and shown next to the composer.
- **Two grouping modes** — one model group per edition with rotation inside it, or one model group per account to pick directly in the model selector.
- **Reasoning effort sharing** — upstream's "Reasoning levels" detection is per-account, so switching to an untested account makes the levels disappear. When enabled (the default), levels detected under any account apply to every account on the same version. Detection happens only on the settings

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Install：**From the plugin market (recommended):** open DSH's Plugin Market, search for `dsh-workbuddy-multi`, and install.

**From the command line (dsh web):**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/richardhxwang/dsh-workbuddy-multi/releases/latest/download/dsh-workbuddy-multi.tgz
```

Reload the page, then open **dsh-workbuddy-multi** on the Plugins page.

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · The dependency installs itself：This plugin needs `dsh-workbuddy-connect`. Once this plugin is installed from the plugin market it checks right away: if the dependency is missing, or installed but disabled, it installs or enables it through the plugin market and shows progress in a notice and on the settings page. Reload the page or restart DSH when prompted. If the automatic attempt fails, the notice shows the reason and a **Retry** button; for the next 6 hours it does not try again on its own, and the **Install** button starts it at any time.

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · The dependency installs itself：

Without a plugin market nothing can be installed automatically; the settings page shows the command instead: ```sh dsh plugin add dsh-workbuddy-connect ```

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Add an account：Click **Add account**, choose China or International, create the sign-in link, open it in a browser or on your phone, and scan with WeChat. The account joins the pool as soon as sign-in succeeds.

The **⋯** menu next to each edition also offers:

- **Import current desktop app account** — reads the account signed in to the WorkBuddy desktop app.
- **Import auth files** — choose auth files (up to 10 at a time); when DSH runs on another machine, expand **Import by path** and enter their paths.

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Add an account：

Each account's **⋯** menu has Renew token, Disable / Enable, Rename and Remove. **Use this** appears only on accounts that can be used right now.

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Rotation：| Mode | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| **On rate limit** (default) | Keep using the current account; on a rate limit or empty quota, pause it until the quota resets and switch to the next available account. |
| **Per request** | Each request uses the next available account. |
| **Manual** | Never switch automatically; only the account set as current is used. |

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Rotation：An account is paused and switched only when WorkBuddy reports a reset time, and the pause lasts until then. Temporary limits without a reset time, such as "model busy", are not tied to an account: the account is kept and DSH retries the request.

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Model groups：| Mode | Behavior | | --- | --- | | **Per edition** (default) | One model group for China and one for International; accounts rotate inside it. | | **Per account** | Each account has its own model group in the model selector. New accounts appear right away. |

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Notes：- **Leave the auth file fields in dsh-workbuddy-connect's settings empty.** `authFile` / `authFileAI` take priority over this plugin, and rotation stops working when they are set. The settings page warns when it detects them.
- **China-edition accounts only work on this computer.** Their credentials are encrypted with the local WorkBuddy app's key.
- **Credentials stay on this computer** in `~/.dsh/workbuddy-pool/` (mode 0600). Neither the settings page nor its API ever shows or returns a token.
- China-edition accounts imported from the desktop app are renewed by `dsh-workbuddy-connect` when used. Sign them in once with **Add account** to have them renewed automatically too.

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Configuration：Usually unnecessary. To change defaults, add to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (switches changed on the settings page take precedence):

```yaml
- id: llm-workbuddy-multi
  config:
    cooldownMs: 1800000      # pause length for an empty quota with no reset time (ms)
    keepalive: true          # automatic token renewal

DSH WorkBuddy Multi-Account README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm test
```
